summary: RUM Group Inc. filed an 8-K announcing it expects to acquire additional Northern Data AG shares from Tether Investments under the previously disclosed November 10, 2025 Transaction Support Agreement, raising ownership from 85.2% to approximately 98% on or about September 30, 2026. RUM also notified Northern Data of intent to commence squeeze-out proceedings under the German Stock Corporation Act for the remaining ~2%, targeting 100% ownership. No price per share, premium, or advisor was disclosed; completion will be reported in a separate 8-K. Watch for the squeeze-out appraisal price and minority-holder litigation risk.
